title: Synthetic transfer below DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-UNDER-CAP

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP - 0.01
steps.expected: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

title: Synthetic transfer at DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-SUCCESS-BOUNDARY

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP
steps.expected: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

title: Synthetic transfer above DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-OVER-CAP

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP + 0.01
steps.expected: the customer sees: This transfer would exceed your daily transfer limit. Please wait until your limit resets or enter a smaller amount.

title: Synthetic transfer below MIN_BALANCE boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-BELOW

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the source balance is MIN_BALANCE - 0.01
steps.expected: the customer sees: This transfer cannot be completed because it would leave your account below the required minimum balance. Please enter a smaller amount.

title: Synthetic transfer at MIN_BALANCE boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-BOUNDARY

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the resulting source balance is MIN_BALANCE
steps.expected: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

title: Synthetic transfer above MIN_BALANCE boundary
preconditions: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-ABOVE

steps.action: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the resulting source balance is MIN_BALANCE + 0.01
steps.expected: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation
